nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Review > Show Markup > bỏ tích Formatting (chỉ còn hiện Insertions and Deletions).  2) Review > Accept > Accept All Changes Shown.  3) Review > Show Markup > tích lại Formatting.  4) Review > Reject > Reject All Changes (lúc này chỉ còn các thay đổi định dạng).
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Review > Show Markup > clear Formatting (only Insertions and Deletions stay visible).  2) Review > Accept > Accept All Changes Shown.  3) Review > Show Markup > check Formatting again.  4) Review > Reject > Reject All Changes (only formatting changes are left now).

cham.de_bai: Accept all tracked insertions and deletions. Reject all formatting changes.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Chèn trang bìa Ion (Dark). Giữ mọi thiết lập mặc định.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Insert the Ion (Dark) cover page. Accept all default settings.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: Insert > Cover Page > Ion (Dark).
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: Insert > Cover Page > Ion (Dark).

cham.de_bai: Insert the Ion (Dark) cover page. Accept all default settings.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Bỏ đường lưới chính (major gridlines) của biểu đồ trong mục “Building with Heart”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Remove the major gridlines from the chart in the “Building with Heart” section.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn biểu đồ.  2) Chart Design > Add Chart Element > Gridlines > bấm Primary Major Vertical để bỏ chọn.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the chart.  2) Chart Design > Add Chart Element > Gridlines > click Primary Major Vertical to clear it.

cham.de_bai: Remove the major gridlines from the chart in the “Building with Heart” section.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Building with Heart”, chèn chú thích (caption) phía trên bảng. Dùng nhãn Table và nội dung chú thích “: Housing data”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Building with Heart” section, insert a caption above the table. Use the Table label and the caption text “: Housing data”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn bảng (hoặc đặt con trỏ trong bảng).  2) References > Insert Caption.  3) Label: Table; Position: Above selected item.  4) Caption: sau "Table 1" gõ thêm ": Housing data" > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the table (or put the cursor in it).  2) References > Insert Caption.  3) Label: Table; Position: Above selected item.  4) Caption: after "Table 1" type ": Housing data" > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Building with Heart” section, insert a caption above the table. Use the Table label and the caption text “: Housing data”.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De07_P7_Bakery_Expert.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới. File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open De07_P7_Bakery_Expert.docx and complete the tasks below in order. Extra files (pictures, data, 3D Models) are in the same work folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Khóa theo dõi thay đổi (Lock Tracking) bằng mật khẩu “Review365”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Lock change tracking by using the password “Review365”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Review > mũi tên Track Changes > Lock Tracking.  2) Nhập Review365 hai lần > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Review > Track Changes arrow > Lock Tracking.  2) Enter Review365 twice > OK.

cham.de_bai: Lock change tracking by using the password “Review365”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Bắt đầu trộn thư (mail merge) kiểu Letters. Dùng workbook Recipients_Bakery.xlsx trong thư mục Files làm danh sách người nhận. Trong đoạn bắt đầu bằng “Dear”, chèn trường trộn First_Name giữa chữ “Dear” và dấu phẩy.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Start a Letters mail merge. Use the Recipients_Bakery.xlsx workbook in the Files folder as the recipient list. In the paragraph that starts with “Dear”, insert the First_Name merge field between the word “Dear” and the comma.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Mailings > Start Mail Merge > Letters.  2) Select Recipients > Use an Existing List > chọn Recipients_Bakery.xlsx > sheet Recipients$ > OK.  3) Đặt con trỏ giữa "Dear " và dấu phẩy > Insert Merge Field > First_Name.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Mailings > Start Mail Merge > Letters.  2) Select Recipients > Use an Existing List > choose Recipients_Bakery.xlsx > sheet Recipients$ > OK.  3) Put the cursor between "Dear " and the comma > Insert Merge Field > First_Name.

cham.de_bai: Start a Letters mail merge. Use the Recipients_Bakery.xlsx workbook in the Files folder as the recipient list. In the paragraph that starts with “Dear”, insert the First_Name merge field between the word “Dear” and the comma.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Tìm mọi đoạn chữ có màu Dark Red và đổi sang màu Blue.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Find all text that is formatted with the Dark Red font color and change the font color to Blue.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Home > Replace > More >> > Find what: để trống > Format > Font > Font color: Dark Red (Standard Colors) > OK.  2) Replace with: để trống > Format > Font > Font color: Blue > OK > Replace All.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Home > Replace > More >> > Find what: leave empty > Format > Font > Font color: Dark Red (Standard Colors) > OK.  2) Replace with: leave empty > Format > Font > Font color: Blue > OK > Replace All.

cham.de_bai: Find all text that is formatted with the Dark Red font color and change the font color to Blue.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Ở cuối đoạn “Name:” (cuối tài liệu), chèn content control kiểu Plain Text. Đặt Title của control là “Name”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: At the end of the paragraph “Name:” at the end of the document, insert a Plain Text content control. Set the title of the control to “Name”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) File > Options > Customize Ribbon > tích Developer (nếu chưa có tab Developer).  2) Đặt con trỏ sau "Name: " ở cuối tài liệu.  3) Developer > Plain Text Content Control > Properties > Title: Name > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) File > Options > Customize Ribbon > check Developer (if the Developer tab is missing).  2) Put the cursor after "Name: " at the end of the document.  3) Developer > Plain Text Content Control > Properties > Title: Name > OK.

cham.de_bai: At the end of the paragraph “Name:” at the end of the document, insert a Plain Text content control. Set the title of the control to “Name”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Ghi macro tên “FormatTitle” lưu chỉ trong tài liệu này, macro áp dụng style Heading 2 cho đoạn văn đang chọn. Lưu tài liệu dạng Word Macro-Enabled Document vào thư mục Documents, giữ nguyên tên file.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Record a macro named “FormatTitle” that is stored in this document only and applies the Heading 2 style to the selected paragraph. Save the document as a Word Macro-Enabled Document in the Documents folder with the same file name.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) View > Macros > Record Macro.  2) Macro name: FormatTitle; Store macro in: tên tài liệu hiện tại (không chọn All Documents) > OK.  3) Home > Styles > Heading 2.  4) View > Macros > Stop Recording.  5) File > Save As > Documents > Save as type: Word Macro-Enabled Document (*.docm) > Save.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) View > Macros > Record Macro.  2) Macro name: FormatTitle; Store macro in: the current document name (not All Documents) > OK.  3) Home > Styles > Heading 2.  4) View > Macros > Stop Recording.  5) File > Save As > Documents > Save as type: Word Macro-Enabled Document (*.docm) > Save.

cham.de_bai: Record a macro named “FormatTitle” that is stored in this document only and applies the Heading 2 style to the selected paragraph. Save the document as a Word Macro-Enabled Document in the Documents folder with the same file name.
